messages:
alex: Pausing the change window. Integration CI failing on artifact upload step, deploybot stuck retrying.

marta: Any logs?

alex: From bk-agent-7 @ 09:22 UTC:
```
[artifact-uploader] chunk 4/6: write returned unexpected EOF
ERROR upload aborted: Unexpected EOF while reading multipart body
```

chris: Could be runner eviction during upload. infra-bot, any GC events?

infra-bot: MONITOR: runner-pool eu-west had a GC spike at 09:20 UTC, reclaimed 5 ephemeral vols.

marta: If we wait we risk missing the change window. Options: retry and hope, or pin last-good artifact and manual-promote.

chris: What's the last promoted digest?

alex: Last promoted commit 1771000001, image sha256:bb12a3c4d5e6. I recommend pin+promote and open infra ticket to harden uploader.

deploy-bot: ACTION: manual promote requires approver. Run `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1771000001 --reason "CI uploader EOF"` to proceed.

marta: I approve. Alex, please add release note blurb for the pin.

alex: Running: `deploybot manual-promote --pin 1771000001 --author @alex`

bk-bot: PROMOTE STARTED: canary rollout for release 2026.03.23-pin-hotfix (pinned sha256:bb12a3c4d5e6).

deploy-bot: PROMOTE SUCCESS: canary healthy. Monitoring 15m.

marta: Draft release note: "Hotfix: pinned to last-known-good artifact (sha256:bb12a3c4d5e6) after intermittent multipart uploader EOF during CI; infra follow-up opened (infra#4755)."

chris: Filed infra#4755: "multipart uploader: handle unexpected EOF and add chunk retry/backoff; investigate runner GC timing."

alex: Temporarily paused aggressive GC in eu-west for 30m. Keeping window open; will rollback if canary degrades. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
